t: You're at St John's Wood Church, an Anglican parish church in St John's Wood. It was designed by Thomas Hardwick, an English architect who was a founding member of the Architects' Club in 1791. Alexander Kyd, who died in 1826, is buried here. I don't have more detail about the church's history, so take your time to look at the building itself, and see what Hardwick's design looks like from where you stand.
